title: The transfer stub
logline: The floor of the bus between the seats: a transfer stub dropped, a gum wrapper, the rubber ribbing of the aisle, a boot that isn't hers. The page is the floor. He never sat above it.

panels.composition: Looking straight down at a bus's aisle floor: rubber ribbing, a dropped paper transfer stub, a gum wrapper, the edge of a stranger's boot, seat legs bolted to the floor.
